text:
maria: Observed sustained p95 tail latency increase for eu-west1 inference pool around 03:12 UTC. Dashboard shows token-level spike correlated with GPU power_limit oscillation on rack11. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: Alert: powercap-fluctuation detected on eu-west1-rack11 (hosts: r11c01-r11c08). Metric: node_gpu_power_limit toggling between ~250W and ~200W at 03:10-03:20 UTC. Tags: powercap, gpu, rack11.

alex: grabbing logs and paging hw-team. maria can you paste the recent `nvidia-smi` snapshot for the affected hosts?

maria: pasting `nvidia-smi` excerpts from r11c01 (collected 03:14 UTC):
```text
Timestamp: 2026-03-17T03:14:02Z
GPU 0: Temp 92C, Pwr: 201W / 250W, Fan 76%, ECC corrected: 3
GPU 1: Temp 65C, Pwr: 120W / 250W, Fan 45%
GPU 3: Temp 78C, Pwr: 249W / 250W, Fan 62%, Xid 31 events: 2
GPU 5: Temp 91C, Pwr: 198W / 250W, Fan 80%, ECC corrected: 5
```

jordan: two localized hotspots (GPU0 & GPU5). Fans are spinning but temps hit ~92C while adjacent cards are much cooler => suspect heatsink mounting or thermal interface issue rather than ambient. Xid 31 events line up with the latency blips (GPU hangs). Recommend draining r11c01 and r11c05 from inference pool ASAP and rerun perf tests.

alex: running drain commands now: `/infra/drain --host r11c01 && /infra/drain --host r11c05` — will report when pods shifted.

lee: FYI @oncall, routing fallback enabled to eu-west2 for customers affected by this pool, and added canary capacity to absorb load. :thumbsup:

maria: after draining the two nodes p95 returned to baseline within ~2 minutes. Confirmed no further Xid events in the remaining pool. Scheduling hardware swap for r11c01 and r11c05 tomorrow AM. Can we mark these as priority replacements? Rack11 has had several high-temp events this month.

jordan: please open a vendor ticket including ECC/Xid logs, temps, and `nvml` dumps. Tag: `hotspot-priority` and reference past rack11 trouble. I'll follow up with thermal probe run during swap.

alex: noted. For the incident postmortem please include: workload -> powercap oscillation -> Xid/ECC correlation, airflow logs, recent power-socket/reserve changes in rack11, and whether kernel/power-management firmware was updated recently.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-3047, assigned to infra-hw, priority P2.

maria: thanks all — closing this thread for now, will update once hardware swap is scheduled and vendor responds.
